channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Christian Braun | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Christian Braun from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: David Adelman on Cam Johnson, Christian Braun
item.description:
David Adelman on Christian Braun, who is doubtful to play tonight:

“I don’t think he’ll play…just want to make sure that his explosion - his comfort level is where it should be. Cam Johnson is the same way.”

David Adelman on Cam Johnson, Christian Braun, Feb 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Christian Braun
item.description:
Nikola Jokić on Christian Braun taking ownership of the turnover & defensive communication:

“The guy is a winner. Whenever he makes a mistake, I’m never mad at him...everybody makes mistakes, but he plays hard.”

Nikola Jokic on Christian Braun, Apr 7, 2025. Source: reddit.

item.title: Jamal Murray on Christian Braun
item.description:
Jamal Murray on Christian Braun:

“He knows what to do to stay on the floor. He’s solid, plays the gaps…he plays with a lot of confidence, like a five-year vet.”

Jamal Murray on Christian Braun, Jun 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Michael Malone on Christian Braun
item.description:
Michael Malone on Christian Braun:

“It speaks to Christian’s confidence. It speaks to him being a winner…he just has stayed ready throughout the year,…That kid never gets too high or too low. I could just feel the confidence oozing off of him.”

Michael Malone on Christian Braun, Jun 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Michael Malone on Christian Braun
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on Christian Braun:

“The thing I talked about all year is that he’s a winner,and here he is in the NBA Finals.”

Michael Malone on Christian Braun, May 29, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.
